spellAccessAndRoute.historicalQuestion: Preserve summoning a POWERFUL WARRIOR FROM YOUR ALLIED FACTION, Core Action/60ft/concentration up to one minute. Define actual allied-faction evidence,available champion selection and a complete finite stat/profile or exact existing reference,including number,size,HP,AC,attacks,defenses,equipment and commands. Decide whether this recruits/transports an existing willing individual or creates a bounded summoned representative; mark any NEW completion explicitly. Preserve identity,consent,custody,inventory,injury and availability so one named person cannot simultaneously occupy two locations or donate duplicate gear. Bind placement,arrival/ending,initiative,command costs,no-command behavior and summon allowances; no automatic faction roster,reputation increase,unique NPC control or unrestricted out-of-range knowledge. Keep the whole faction/Haven audit and ingredient availability separate; no cosmological origin is inferred.

historicalProposalEvidence.procedure: KEEP Action,one NEW warrior,60feet,concentration up to60seconds and FROM YOUR ALLIED FACTION. NEW resolve allied mechanically as one genuine canonical factionId with the caster's current standing above0at both commitment and resolution, using reviewed−3..+3 institutional records, plus no currently explicit faction ban on invoking its aid. This source-specific gate is not a general claim that all positive standing creates membership or magical access. Select that actual faction before payment. The spell creates one bounded summoned representative in that faction's known ordinary martial appearance, not a transported/copied named NPC or a promise that every real faction member consents to the caster's actions. It is a new temporary manifestation authorized by this spell's faction gate and carries no private faction memories,secret identity,rank,mandate to sign contracts or ability to issue institutional orders. It cannot impersonate a specific real unique official for an automatic credential benefit. NEW complete profile: Medium Humanoid-shaped magical companion (creature type Humanoid for actual targeting),baseHP70,AC18,walk30,bodyweight180lb,STR18,DEX12,CON16,INT10,WIS12,CHA12; six saves use original source owner's current PB total, other checks use printed ability modifiers without proficiencies. Ordinary sight/hearing, no darkvision,immunity,resistance,extra Reaction,spellcasting or trained trade. One commanded melee attack5feet using original owner's current spell-attack modifier,2d8+that owner's current PB slashing. A normal critical doubles only attack dice, not the PB flat. Its apparent martial armor,weapon and shield are intrinsic profile manifestations, not separate item grants,transferred faction stock or detachable loot. Use the shared owner BA command/attached phase/offensive allowance, with uncommanded defensive Move/Dodge; it knows its basic command channel but no generic spoken faction language or information-report ability. One Faction Champion per original owner across all factions, not one slot for each affiliation. A successful new creation replaces the prior body, while normal concentration commitment already ends an incompatible old spell. Hidden loss of faction eligibility prevents formation without reporting secret institutional facts; legal costs remain spent. Once formed, a later ordinary standing change does not create remote mind reading or immediate punitive attack; the admitted finite body persists until its real ending, with no new faction authority. Its creation/acts produce no automatic reputation gain,recruit roster seat,opening of Haven,free hireling or promised faction support outside this minute. Actual observed conduct/claims may still have real social consequences under EX58. It cannot undertake offscreen jobs,fill an expedition office,teach a formula or become an independent long-term character merely because its shape is a warrior. Genuine independently supplied objects have real inventory,load and custody; the intrinsic equipment is never copied out. At ending/suppression use the finite created-body procedure, preserving actualHPloss/sourceclock and real-item drops. No named person loses HP,inventory,injuries or availability at another location because no such person was transported. No cosmological source,plane,soul or faction divinity is inferred.
historicalProposalEvidence.newChoices: NEW current positive-standing/explicit-aid-ban gate, bounded created representative instead of an existing named NPC, full70HP/18AC/2d8+PB profile, one slot across factions and shared command/offense. Real affiliation and reputation consequences remain distinct from fabricated membership/gear.
workedCases: CJ5-07-A: A genuinely positive-standing faction qualifies at creation. The one champion's commanded attack uses Wizard+8and rolls2d8=11plusPB4for15slashing, with no extra companion attack granted. Its apparent shield and armor are intrinsicAC18, not two free sellable items taken from a distant faction armory.

CJ5-07-B: The caster cannot create one champion from each of three friendly factions to gain three source slots; this spell permits one per owner across all factions. An actual later standing decrease does not duplicate or teleport a real officer into its body. On expiry a genuinely borrowed lantern drops intact, while the manifested weapon leaves no harvestable item or NPC corpse.

spellAccessAndRoute.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP; concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds. Before payment choose one canonical factionId and satisfy AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01: actual alliedStatus=true, current standing >0, actual invocation permission, and no explicit aid prohibition. Positive standing alone, faction membership alone, Faction Ally membership+permission, or Faction Portal standing+HQ are not substitutes. Hidden loss of eligibility can prevent formation after a paid cast without revealing secret institutional facts.

NEW interpretation of `summon a powerful warrior from your allied faction`: create one bounded temporary Faction Champion representative using AC5-PROFILE-FACTION-CHAMPION-01, rather than transporting/copying a named real NPC. It has no private faction memories, real official identity/rank, contracting authority, secrets or institutional command. Intrinsic martial gear is profile manifestation, not faction inventory/loot.

Place the Medium body in one perceived supported unoccupied fitting footprint within 60 feet/LoE. Use shared Companion Command/global offense rules and its one Champion Strike. One Champion per owner across all factions. A later standing change does not remotely end an already admitted body; the source continues until concentration/expiry/replacement/dismissal/ordinary non-Null 0 HP or real removal.

Apply AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01/accepted Null lifecycle: qualifying Null damage reaching 0 gives Disabled 0 while source persists; repeated Null hits do not create ordinary death; legal ordinary living-ally HP healing can restore above 0. Under Lesser Antimagic use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01. Genuine borrowed items remain real/drop normally; intrinsic gear vanishes. No automatic reputation gain, expedition seat, hireling, formula teaching, faction credential, soul/native origin or distant-NPC injury exists.

sharedRule.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
sharedRule.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.
